scope: Unattended offline Gen7 VMA contract and pure extent checking, no native import qualification.

result.reference_revision: 453d8875f815bf9dfad9035982861226a4823a6c; reference not Xiaomi exact stock source
findings: Dynamic path reserves ALIGN(md->size,size_alignment) before calling gmu_core_map_memdesc; VA alignment is separate. Mapping length can be smaller than reservation; the comment explicitly preserves a VA hole.

Dynamic failure searches find_va(vma,md->gmuaddr,size), while addr is the just-reserved local address and md->gmuaddr is assigned in the success branch. Without the exact lower helper body, whether failure has mutated md->gmuaddr remains unknown. Native retention must not assume this lookup retires the attempted reservation.

Static path selects next_va only when input addr is zero; next_va advances by rounded size only after successful mapping. Explicit-address validation and caller serialization need independent binding; no aperture constants or addresses are adopted.

gen7_free_gmu_block keeps its VMA node if iommu_unmap returns fewer bytes than md->size, but still reaches sharedmem_free. This source behavior does not authorize native release after uncertain DMA/unmap.

Current NativeAdrenoVm::findAddress searches mapped spans; NativeVm map covers actual memory bytes. It does not implement a separate Gen7 rounded reservation ledger for unmapped tail bytes. The previous handle0/retained-refs finding is reused, not retested.
Real Gen7 reservation owner, aperture, domain/context/route, per-request mapping attributes and power/stop lifetime are missing. No callable native import adapter was fabricated.
result.new_component: Pure ZGCheckGmuExtent rederives the existing decoded request without a new codec. It checks supplied backing is page-sized/covers request and reservation rounds BACKING length, retaining separate VA/size alignment and unbacked-tail byte count. It rejects secure/fixed/preallocated paths. Counts remain caller data; no address, native status, handle, ACK or authority is emitted.
result.initial_checker_failure: Expected source corruption removed a token; ValueError escaped the static negative-control handler before host/target checks. Checker preimage/refusal retained; only missing-token refusal handling corrected, production source/flags unchanged.
limits: Fully unattended: physical_assistance_available=false. No device execution authorization remains; no phone/USB/provider/allocator/cache/SMEM/MMIO/SCM/PAS/power/clock/reset/SMMU map/unmap/IOVA/GPU calls. No new runtime caller/FD/kernel/device candidate.

Ordinary extent arithmetic is not an ownership or observed-backing result. Missing native context/routing, lifetime, attributes/permissions and genuine stop proof remain unavailable. Do not adopt legacy A6xx/A740 constants or translate DT SID into authority.
No new codec, query/HFI/272B/ZORNGQF1/normal-log field/fragment/carrier or EFI/Darwin pointer handoff. Preserve old capsules/profiles/manifests and all consumed claims.
Do not repeat new reference3/extent3/native3 or prior composition/publisher/registry/startup/HFI/CPU GUI suites. Only new exact helper/retention source checks and current target evidence.
If physical assistance becomes necessary or bounded recovery fails, stop device operations, save concrete evidence/plan and notify; no improvised flash/recovery/shutdown.
